Due to a permanent no-fly zone, direct drone travel between Station Alpha and Station Beta is strictly prohibited.
Furthermore, owing to a critical scheduling conflict with overlapping maintenance windows, the inspection circuit must incorporate exactly one of the following two flight corridors: the corridor between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the corridor between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient flight path, measured in total kilometers traveled, that visits every monitoring station precisely once and concludes its circuit at the station where it originated.
